notes: Copies the element's value and weight into an 8-byte block owned by the group, appends it, then bumps the element count (+0x38), the exclusion window (+0x3c) when the raw window (+0x40) is -1, and the total weight (+0x48). The caller NativePlaylist::AddPlaylistElement now passes a stack record (asm 0x8838c4 passes its address and has no allocation). A failed block allocation stops here; the original writes without a check.

Returns the vtable +0x28 result (the Mutex::Unlock int of VoxEngineInternal::SetMasterGain). Without an engine it returns 0; the listing returns the address of m_internal there, a register leftover with no int form.

Returns the vtable +0x24 result (the Mutex::Unlock int of VoxEngineInternal::SetGroupGain). Without an engine it returns 0; the listing returns a GOT-derived address there, a register leftover with no int form.

Mixes every source through its FillBuffer slot (+0x60) into 2*count words, then clamps to 16-bit output. The listing's float return is a register leftover (the mix buffer pointer on the full path); the only caller, FillBuffer (0x8906a0), does not read it.

Returns the Mutex::Unlock int (every exit is a tail call to Unlock). The base slot +0x4c (DriverSourceInterface, 0x88fcd8) is BX LR in the binary; the port's base returns 0 so the override keeps its type. Only the zero-request path is covered by a test.

Returns the Mutex::Unlock int (tail call). Missing (one item): word 0 of the template for each new ring element (sp+0x20) is never stored by the original, so the binary copies an uninitialised stack word; the port writes 0.

Returns the Mutex::Unlock int (tail call); VoxEngineInternal::SetDSPEmitterParameter now returns the ReleaseReadAccess int. Missing (one item): the null-value path for parameter 0, where the listing calls strlen on null (undefined behaviour); the port treats the value as an empty name.

Returns the current element index (int, as before). Missing (one item): next_event_ on the peek path reads loop-list words [2] and [1] without a length check; the port assumes at least three words, which is not verified.

Body ported for all paths. Missing (one item): the return value. The paths return UpdateSegmentsStates' int, the kind-1 chunk index (int), or the peeked PlaylistElement pointer (no int form), so the port returns void.

Stores the index, the chunk from the state list and dispatches on field_90. Missing (one item): the transition-table lookup made when field_38 is 0 or more (a 12-byte outer record whose entries are 8 bytes; the port's transitions_ layout differs). Its return is the InterpretTransitionRule leftover.

Returns the VoxEngineInternal::UpdateEmitters int (now ported with its release int). Missing (one item): _GetTime is a stand-in clock (steady_clock in EngineGetTime); the elapsed times match but the absolute stamp does not. Without an engine it returns 0 (the listing returns the this pointer).
Calls UpdateSourcesThreaded, then returns UpdateEmittersThreaded's int (tail call in the listing). VoxEngineInternal::UpdateSources and UpdateEmitters are defined.

Engine init, the stream and decoder factory registrations, and both thread objects are ported. Missing (one item): the return value. The listing returns the low word of the start time (_GetTime double, gettimeofday epoch); the port's stand-in clock has another epoch, so that int is not carried. A missing engine returns the this pointer in the listing (not carried).
